responsibility: Defines the ISO interface for exposing program arguments as an input channel. It provides access to the argument-reading ChanId and operations to test whether an argument is currently available and advance to the next argument, so higher-level text I/O code can consume argv data through the standard channel abstraction.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for the ProgramArgs pair, declaring ArgChan, IsArgPresent, and NextArg for consuming argv through a channel; ProgramArgs.mod is the companion device implementation that copies argv data, tracks argument position, and hooks it into the generic I/O framework.
